'''Mie cakalang''' is a traditional [[Indonesian cuisine|Indonesian]] [[skipjack tuna]] [[noodle]] soup from [[Manado cuisine|Manado]], [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.indonesiakaya.com/jelajah-indonesia/detail/mie-cakalang-sajian-mie-dengan-aroma-ikan-cakalang-khas-manado|title=Mie Cakalang, Sajian Mie dengan aroma Ikan Cakalang Khas Manado {{!}} - Eksplorasi Budaya di Zamrud Khatulistiwa|language=id|website=IndonesiaKaya.com |access-date=2017-12-12}}</ref> ''Mie'' means "noodle", while ''cakalang'' is Manado dialect for "skipjack tuna".

The [[noodle soup]] is noted for its savoury ''cakalang'' fish aroma. Its ingredients includes yellow [[noodle]], [[skipjack tuna]], [[choy sum]], [[cabbages]], [[chili pepper]], [[scallion]], [[shallot]] and [[garlic]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.femina.co.id/ikan-seafood/resep-mie-kuah-cakalang-|title=Resep Mie Kuah Cakalang|last=Indonesia|first=Femina|website=www.femina.co.id|language=en|access-date=2017-12-12}}</ref>
